ability.name: The Lantern
ability.role: necromancer — raises fallen zombies as husks until killed
behaviour: raises one dead enemy every 6 s as a husk at 50 % HP
lamp glow lights the area — it is always visible in fog
counters: fire trail denies the corpse line

art.silhouette: Tall robed skeleton conductor in a wide-brimmed witch hat, holding a caged lantern on a chain.
art.pose: three-quarter front, standing, lamp arm raised
features: caged lantern with a cyan flame on a chain
glowing cyan eye sockets in a stitched skull
mechanical forearm and exposed rib cage
rope belt over a ragged robe
art.notes: Side-on card art; the creature is cut from the card, title and stat panel removed.
